messages:
lina: Heads up — saw multiple reports that the console p50/p95 tiles show better numbers than the endpoint view for /v1/respond. Customers think latency improved. But our SLO checks show no change.

noah: I reproduced: console rollup p50=85ms, endpoint p50=140ms for the same hour. p95 discrepancy smaller but still present.

maria: Any recent changes to rollup algorithm? Quantile method, sampling, or header tagging?

jamal: Recent change: we enabled lightweight GK quantiles for global rollups to save space. Endpoint still calculates exact quantiles from raw samples. GK can under-estimate median if child shards have skewed distributions or differing sample densities.

lina: That explains algorithmic error, but product says this is a visibility problem — users glance at tiles and make decisions. We need a UI fix ASAP.

tess: UX short-term: add a small method badge on percentile tiles: e.g., "p50 · approx(GK) · 2.3k samples". If method != exact and route has an SLO, show a subtle warning: "Approx rollup used; click to show endpoint exacts."

product-zoe: Product: agree. Also want a global preference for SLO dashboards to always prefer endpoint/exact numbers when available. Rollups OK for overview but SLO pages must be precise.

jamal: Telemetry/infra note: emitting rollup.meta.quantile_method and rollup.meta.sample_count is cheap. We can add that to aggregator output today.

oncall-jen: Operational caveat: some clusters (dedicated) don't stream endpoint raws into central store; prefer_endpoint_hint won't be present everywhere. UI should fall back to rollup when endpoint missing and show a short explain copy.

maria: Also consider adding a "confidence" score for each percentile (simple heuristic based on sample_count and method). If confidence low, tile gets an amber outline.

lina: Good idea. Quick heuristic: confidence = (method == exact) ? high : (sample_count >= 1000 ? medium : low). We'll iterate.

noah: We should also add a server-side audit that compares rollup vs endpoint p50/p95 for SLO routes nightly and emits a list of routes where delta > 10%. That helps decide which routes get exact rollups.

jamal: I can add the audit job after the aggregator change. Longer term we can flip critical routes to exact quantiles or increase retention/tdigest precision.

product-zoe: Timeline: product wants the UI badge + endpoint-prefer toggle behind a feature flag in one week. If infra emits method+count this week, front-end can mock while backend finishes.

tess: I'll prototype the badge and the in-tile "Prefer endpoint" action behind a flag. Also will add a tooltip copy: "Rollup uses approximate quantiles; endpoint numbers may differ."

oncall-jen: I'll schedule a small canary for the aggregator metadata change and validate values across clusters. Also adding runbook: when support sees mismatch, check rollup.meta.quantile_method and sample_count, then run the audit query:
```sql
SELECT hour, rollup.p50 AS rollup_p50, endpoint.p50 AS endpoint_p50, rollup.meta.quantile_method, rollup.meta.sample_count
FROM latency_rollups rollup
LEFT JOIN latency_endpoints endpoint USING(route,hour)
WHERE route='/v1/respond' AND hour BETWEEN '2026-04-10T12:00' AND '2026-04-10T13:00';
```

maria: One more: ensure alerting docs clarify which metric source is used for SLOs. We should avoid surprise when people tweak UI and think alerts will follow.

product-zoe: We'll update product docs and add a short note in the SLO editor: "Alerts use endpoint-exact metrics where available."

lina: Ok team — jamal please open the aggregator PR for method+count. Tess will prototype UI. Product will own rollout. Oncall will watch after canary.

-- end of thread --
